title: Features list
description: Machine-readable feature contract. The harness flips state; the agent never self-asserts.

version.description: Schema version. Bump when breaking changes land in this schema.

project.description: Optional project identifier (e.g. 'seka.works'). Helpful for runners that batch across repos.

id.description: Stable slug. Used in commit messages, run logs, and cross-references.

behavior.description: One-sentence statement of what the feature does, written so a fresh reader can verify it.

verification.description: Shell command that returns exit 0 if the feature is passing. The runner invokes this verbatim from the project root.

state.description: Lifecycle state. Only the runner writes 'passing' and 'blocked'. The agent may set 'not_started', 'active', or 'retired'.

evidence.description: Tail of the verification output captured by the most recent runner pass. Null until a run has happened.

last_run.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent runner pass.

depends_on.description: Other feature ids that must be 'passing' before this one can move out of 'blocked'.
